{{Quote|We have many collectors interested in artifacts from a lost city in the Asutvu Rift. Treasures that we are unable to provide. A cult has firmly embedded themselves in the city's ruins. No one can even approach, let alone enter the site.|[[Shak Los]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|A Conservative Proposal|Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Asutvu Rift''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] area located near the [[Invasion Zone]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="RitR" /> By [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> the Rift had become the site for the [[Syphus Collective]], specifically within the [[Temple of the Progenitor]]. Following the [[invasion of Manaan]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Krallet Division]] was sent to the Rift but was ambushed by the [[Alliance Commander]], who had been sent by [[Wo Kasto]] of the [[Manaan Special Warfare Group]].<ref name="RitR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Asutvu Rift first appeared in the daily area for Manaan introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
